title: The Defense Rests: A Courtroom-Inspired Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Automated Safety Case Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.21618v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Safety cases are widely used to demonstrate that mission-critical systems, such as autonomous vehicles and unmanned aerial systems, can operate safely after deployment. However, manually constructing safety cases is complex, time-consuming, and labor-intensive, which calls for the proposal of automated approaches to support their creation. Inspired by the legal nature of safety case construction, we formalize the safety case creation problem through a courtroom analogy, where stakeholders collaboratively propose, examine, criticize, review, improve and validate safety claims and their supporting evidence. In this analogy, the safety analyst acts as a prosecutor by identifying hazards and safety concerns, while the assurance case developer serves as a defense attorney by constructing and substantiating safety arguments. translated_title: 辩方举证完毕：一个受法庭启发的多智能体大语言模型框架，用于自动化安全论证生成
translated_abstract: 安全论证（safety cases）被广泛用于证明任务关键系统（如自动驾驶车辆和无人机系统）在部署后能够安全运行。然而，手动构建安全论证过程复杂、耗时且劳动强度大，因此需要提出自动化方法来支持其创建。受安全论证构建的法律属性启发，我们通过法庭审判的类比将安全论证创建问题形式化，其中各利益相关方协作地提出、审查、批评、评审、改进和验证安全主张及其支持证据。在这一类比中，安全分析师扮演检察官的角色，负责识别危害和安全问题；保证论证开发人员则扮演辩护律师的角色，负责构建和证实安全论证；编排器（orchestrator）扮演法官的角色，负责协调各利益相关方之间的互动；评审委员会则扮演陪审团的角色，负责评估……
tldr: 本文提出了一种受法庭审判启发的多智能体大语言模型框架，通过模拟检察官、辩护律师、法官和陪审团等角色协作，实现任务关键系统安全论证的自动化生成。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a courtroom-inspired multi-agent LLM framework that automates the generation of safety cases for mission-critical systems by simulating collaborative stakeholder roles including prosecutor, defense attorney, judge, and jury.
